desc: Determine whether the enrolled appended-payload shape is FIXABLE in m1n1 rather than merely unsupported — if it is, milestone B0 revives without any USB/NVMe dependency. Measured fact: with the bare 1.1 MiB loader enrolled, m1n1 scans base+0x10C000 (=0x10004938000) and finds its OWN .rodata there ('[AFK]%s send cmd:' from src/afk.c, magic 5b41464b), while bootargs.top_of_kernel_data=0x10004FA8000 shows iBoot reserving ~7.5 MiB of kernel-data from base 0x1000482C000. Investigate offline from source: how _payload_start is computed for the m1n1-raw link vs the macho link; whether m1n1-raw.ld places BSS or other sections past _payload_start (which would make an appended payload overlap m1n1's own runtime memory); whether m1n1 self-relocates and what that does to the payload base; and how iBoot's raw kernelcache load interacts with the 7.5 MiB kernel-data reservation. Deliverable: either an exact reviewed m1n1 change that makes an appended payload discoverable on the enrolled path, or a definitive statement that the raw enrolled shape cannot host a payload and why. Evidence: evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md. OFFLINE ONLY; any resulting m1n1 change needs independent review + a separate rig ticket. RESULT 2026-07-25 (claude): CONCLUDED — iBoot never enters m1n1 when the appended region contains payload-like content. probe-fdt-only.bin (1.10 MiB, m1n1+DTB only) shows ONLY the Apple logo then the 5 s loop, though a DTB without a kernel would force a running m1n1 to print 'No valid payload found' and render its whole log via fb_set_active(true). Five agreeing lines: no panel text, no gadget even with a 60 s window, no kboot logbuf in the top 2 MiB of RAM, loop period 5 s for both EARLY_PROXY_TIMEOUT=5 and =60, and 1.10 MiB failing while payload-free 14/16/20 MiB objects boot. The appended-payload shape is therefore unusable on J614s; m1n1/kernel/DTB/initramfs are NOT implicated (never reached; all remain chainload-proven). Next: payload obfuscation (XOR-mask the appended region so no gz/xz/FDT/cpio magic or ASCII bootargs appears, plus a short m1n1 patch to unmask in place before payload_run) — works under either reading of the iBoot check and needs no USB/NVMe/HPM work. Evidence: evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md. ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED 2026-07-25 (claude): enrolled raw boot objects must have a TOTAL SIZE that is a multiple of the 16 KiB page size. m1n1-b0-diet-aligned.bin (f290833c, 578 x 16 KiB = the looping object + 14,796 zero bytes) BOOTS. Non-aligned objects are never executed: no m1n1 entry, no panel output, no gadget, no logbuf, iBoot resetting ~5 s x5 then the reinstall screen. Supersedes all earlier theories (size in MiB, compression, kernel size, m1n1 prefix, discovery, SEPFW, load extent, proxy window, content/obfuscation). Cause of the long hunt: every control was accidentally page-aligned (truncate -s Nm, 64 KiB blocks, and m1n1-raw.ld's 0x4000 section alignment), so controls differed from test cases in an untracked variable. FIXED in scripts/t6040-build-raw-object.py, which now pads and asserts the invariant and reproduces f290833c byte-identically. 129 CLOSED.
